name: TextAutoShrinkFitter
src_typeComment: TMP already supports auto-sizing, but it needs several settings configured together correctly (enableAutoSizing + fontSizeMin/Max + word-wrap + an overflow fallback) to actually behave like "shrink to fit this box, wrap first, never overflow" — this is exactly that bundle, in one component with clear tooltips, instead of hunting through the Inspector each time.

src_serialized.name: allowWrapping
src_serialized.tooltip: If true, text wraps across multiple lines before shrinking further. If false, it shrinks toward a single line.

src_members.name: Apply
src_members.comment: Public so re-applying after changing minFontSize/maxFontSize/allowWrapping at runtime takes effect immediately instead of waiting for the next Awake.
